programs.title: Here is how we partner with you:
programs.p1Body: The Colorado Heritage Independent School, a private Christian school, provides homeschooling families “umbrella school” services (record keeping, etc.). Homeschooling families who are not enrolled in an independent school must report their records to a public school district. Students enrolled in our Independent School are considered private school students, and as such, submit records to Colorado Heritage. We also provide curriculum and scheduling advice, as well as encouragement, to families who are pursuing the noble pursuit of educating at home.
programs.p2Body: For over 30 years, Colorado Heritage has provided quality Christ-centered K - 12 classes, meeting the academic needs of homeschooling families. Our elementary and junior high classes are varied, stimulating, and fulfilling. Many of our high school Diploma Program students take our challenging high school classes, crafting a robust 4-year plan. Our Academy also offers great fellowship opportunities with like-minded homeschoolers.
programs.p3Body: Our Diploma Program provides home-educated high school students with a 4-year high school plan that challenges and encourages them both academically and spiritually. Many of our Diploma Program students pursue much of their course work through our Academy along with classes taken at home. Upon successfully completing our Diploma Program, students will receive a private Christian school transcript and have the option of participating in our graduation ceremony. Colleges and other institutions highly esteem our high school graduates. Four diploma levels are available to pursue: Diploma, Honors, High Honors, and Highest Honors.

mission.title: Thankful for God’s provision and faithfulness.
mission.body: Colorado Heritage Education School System is thankful for God’s provision and faithfulness to us over the past 30+ years as we have worked to serve the needs of home educators here in Colorado, across the United States, and around the world.
